metadata.policy: Scenario exceptions, then Fifth Edition rules, then annex class and dated refit entries. Legacy dated Form 10 is corroboration, with differences retained explicitly. Nulls and unresolved alternatives are not executable; printed conflicts are retained verbatim and marked.
restrictions: Shell selections: 8in APC, 6in APC, 5in SpCOM, 12.7cm COM. The source leaves per-ship loadouts unresolved.
